newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 falls despite major issue rebound.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 falls despite major issue rebound.

text.p: Major issues on the Prague bourse bounced back on Thursday but failed to prevent the 13th straight decline on the PX50 index.

Ceska Sporitelna, which fell one crown to 330, was the only major issue to lose ground. SPT Telecom gained 30 crowns to 3,080, CEZ rose one crown to 1,015 and Komercni Banka closed up 14 crowns to 2,209.
In spite of the rebound from the three largest issues on the bourse, dealers cautioned against interpreting the turnaround as the beginning of a sustained upturn.
"Tomorrow these three major issues could go anywhere," said Oldrich Pavlovsky of Patria Finance.
"I don't expect a strong upward move after today. Supply and demand looks to be in the balance now in the high liquidity shares," he added.

Trading on the Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) as a whole was very thin. During continuous trading, just 6.2 million crowns worth of shares changed hands. Total turnover for the day on the bourse was 596 million crowns.
